title: Capstone: an equity research report
audience: a finance graduate or career changer preparing for the CFA Program exams and a career in investment analysis
purpose: Produce a professional-quality initiation report on a public company: thesis, industry and competitive analysis, financial analysis, a full model and valuation, a price target and recommendation, risks and catalysts, an ESG and governance review, and a pitch, revised after feedback.
primary_reading: CFA Institute Research Challenge: free guidance and past reports

weeks.1: Choosing a company and a question

blocks.deliverable: Draft the business and industry sections.
Week 7 midterm; present a draft valuation for feedback.
Revise the report and give the final pitch.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Initiation report: a 10 to 15 page research report with a tested model, valuation, price target, risks and an ESG and governance review on a public company of your choice, revised after a peer review, plus a ten-minute recorded pitch and answers to five hard questions.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
